$comment: NEWS-class watchlist for fast-news-alerts Phase 2. Edit by hand. The poller (scripts/refresh-news-alerts.mjs) fires a Telegram alert when a fresh macro-headline mentions one of these tickers/aliases. Match is word-boundary anchored; sectorKeywords only count when they co-occur with a ticker hit. Do NOT add broad macro terms (Fed/rate hike/war/oil shock/risk-off) here — those are the REGIME class delivered by the macro cron, and duplicating them would double-fire (see CLAUDE.md fast-news-alerts).
